name: New Phyrexia
description: New Phyrexia is the Phyrexian-ruled plane that was once Mirrodin, from which the Phyrexians launched their invasion of the Multiverse.

summary.text: New Phyrexia is the Phyrexian-ruled plane that was once Mirrodin, from which the Phyrexians launched their invasion of the Multiverse.

bio.text: Urza discovers the dark plane of Phyrexia at the end of the war and begins a millennia-long vendetta against Yawgmoth and Phyrexia.
Karn's created world is twisted by Phyrexia's influence, and he later becomes the Father of Machines and leader of Phyrexia while losing his mind.
New Phyrexian horrors emerge from Mirrodin's core, and the slow spread becomes an active campaign that compleats Mirrodin and overwhelms the Mirrans.
Tezzeret serves Phyrexia and tells captives that experiments in the lab test the connection between body and soul for it.
A strike team invades New Phyrexia, where Kaito is hypnotized by electrostatic wind on arrival.
Elesh Norn, the Mother of Machines, leads the invasion forces, and Geralf explains that the Phyrexians seek to turn Innistrad into an outpost of their empire.
Afterward Nahiri tears Phyrexia's metal from Zendikar, and Jace goes to Ravnica, which is at war with the Phyrexians.

status.text: The latest story, in 2024, shows the Phyrexians still at war with Ravnica as Jace searches for Vraska's mind, and a 2025 story has Ajani confess to Elspeth that he joined Phyrexia willingly.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals his fear: threats from the Eldrazi, an ancient dragon planeswalker and Phyrexia could destroy Theros while even the gods are powerless.
timeline.quote: even the gods may be powerless to stop them.

timeline.summary: Ajani recalls that Elspeth left Dominaria for Mirrodin, which other planeswalkers now say is dead with Phyrexia returned.
timeline.quote: Then other Planeswalkers had spread the word: Mirrodin is dead. Phyrexia has returned.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret appears and tells them the experiments are about testing the connection between body and soul for Phyrexia, thanking them for bringing planeswalkers to the lab.
timeline.quote: And kami are much easier to come by than what Phyrexia really needs."

timeline.summary: In the Phyrexian laboratory Tamiyo awakens Phyrexianized, loyal to Phyrexia and calling it her new family.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia was her new home.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias announces the first Phyrexianized planeswalker and Tezzeret asks whether Elesh Norn knows.
timeline.quote: Does Elesh Norn know you've succeeded in creating the first Phyrexianized planeswalker?"

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reaches Elesh Norn at the heart of the plane, where she takes Karn's torso and welcomes him to the great work.
timeline.quote: We welcome you to our great work.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn tells Tezzeret he will be herald on Dominaria; he realizes she will not give him his body and resolves to wage war on her.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn had no intention of fulfilling her promise.

timeline.summary: Karn speaks of Jhoira and is cut off by Elesh Norn; Tezzeret sees it as a good move on his part.
timeline.quote: Jhoira . . . Jhoira is my friend . . . my best friend.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn dismisses Tezzeret, who leaves angrily.
timeline.quote: With a growl, Tezzeret turned and walked away.

timeline.summary: Kaito, hit by a wall of electrostatic wind on entering New Phyrexia, lies hypnotized on the metal beach, sure it is paradise.
timeline.quote: New Phyrexia wasn't a peril, it was a paradise, and he should just relax and let it wash over him

timeline.summary: The Wanderer shakes Kaito and strikes him in the face, breaking the hypnotic spell so that he hears the battle around him.
timeline.quote: he realized that what he'd taken for the sound of waves was actually the sound of metal clashing on metal

timeline.summary: Kaito finds his sword and tanuki drone gone, and the Wanderer begins flickering out of the plane.
timeline.quote: He grabbed instinctively for his sword

timeline.summary: Nahiri kills a Phyrexian construct by summoning the metal sand against it and driving her blade through it.
timeline.quote: She twisted once, and the shape beneath the mounded sand was still.

timeline.summary: Nahiri explains that a planar shield scattered the team on arrival, and that she shook off the sand's hypnosis because it is made of metal.
timeline.quote: we slammed into some sort of planar shield when we breached New Phyrexia

timeline.summary: Nahiri reveals a scratch on her neck and shows her blood still runs red, assuring Kaito she is fine.
timeline.quote: My blood's still red. No oil. I'll be fine.

timeline.summary: Elspeth wakes alone on New Phyrexia and fights off six Phyrexians until Kaya joins her.
timeline.quote: a purple-tinged blade thrust through a Phyrexian heart

timeline.summary: Chandra and Wrenn arrive on New Phyrexia and find a bright landscape dominated by a vast Invasion Tree.
timeline.quote: Chandra can't comprehend how tall the Invasion Tree is.

timeline.summary: They find Mirran survivors under Koth and Melira, and Chandra pitches that Wrenn will bond with the tree to guide it.
timeline.quote: We'll head for the tree. Once we're there, I'll attach myself to him, and try to guide him,

timeline.summary: Koth says Karn was taken near the tree and agrees to try to take control of the tree and rescue him.
timeline.quote: We may as well try to gain control of the tree and rescue him at the same time.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains the guarded pathways and why he helps, saying he serves no one.
timeline.quote: Urabrask serves no one.

timeline.summary: They plan to have Koth launch Chandra and Wrenn across a chasm while the Mirrans distract Norn.
timeline.quote: The rest of the Mirrans will provide a tantalizing distraction for the so-called Mother of Machines.

timeline.summary: Koth launches Chandra and Wrenn through the air, and bladed bats attack.
timeline.quote: Koth drives his fist into the earth.

timeline.summary: Geralf explains the Phyrexians seek to turn Innistrad into an outpost of their empire, and that their oil cannot infect risen dead.
timeline.quote: They wish to transform our glorious home into one more outpost along their long road to empire.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Eight tear holes across planes and see the Phyrexian invasion everywhere.
timeline.quote: Fires churning in his belly, Eight reaches for new planes.

timeline.summary: Wrenn grows a massive portal as Elspeth is flung through the gate by a war engine, and the Phyrexian army pours through into Zhalfir's peaceful land.
timeline.quote: The monstrosity flings the angel through the gate

timeline.summary: Jace planeswalks to Ravnica, which is at war with the Phyrexians, and searches for Vraska's mind.
timeline.quote: Ravnica is at war, again

timeline.summary: Kaito and Jace quarrel over their fight on New Phyrexia and the sylex.
timeline.quote: Last time I saw you, we were trying to kill each other on New Phyrexia!

timeline.summary: Ajani confesses to Elspeth that he joined Phyrexia willingly and apologizes for trying to kill her.
timeline.quote: I was not forced. I was not compelled. I did it willingly.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Tam found the Theorist's earlier self lost in a vision of Phyrexia's attack on Vryn.
timeline.quote: She knows without doubt that this was Vryn under Phyrexian attack

timeline.summary: At the end of the war, Urza discovers the dark plane of Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: At the end of this war, Urza discovered the dark plane of Phyrexia

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight and its crew, with the Legacy including Karn, thwart Phyrexia's near invasion of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia nearly invaded Dominaria, were it not for the skyship Weatherlight and its crew.

timeline.summary: Karn's created world is twisted by the influence of Phyrexia through his own accidental actions.
timeline.quote: that world became twisted by the influence of Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Karn is determined to stop at nothing until the Phyrexians are destroyed.
timeline.quote: Karn will stop at nothing until they are destroyed.

timeline.summary: New Phyrexian horrors emerge from Mirrodin's core, killing all Mirrans in their path.
timeline.quote: New Phyrexian horrors continue to emerge from Mirrodin's core, killing all Mirrans in their path

timeline.summary: Urabrask's red-aligned Phyrexian faction allows Mirrodin's citizens safe harbor.
timeline.quote: Its red-aligned faction, led by Urabrask, turns a blind eye to the citizens of Mirrodin, allowing them safe harbor.

timeline.summary: Losing his mind, Karn becomes the Father of Machines and leader of Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Slowly losing his mind, Karn became the Father of Machines and the leader of Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: The slow spread becomes an active campaign to compleat Mirrodin, and the Mirrans are overwhelmed.
timeline.quote: The Mirrans fought many battles, but they soon were overwhelmed by the Phyrexian forces.

timeline.summary: Urza predicts Tevesh Szat's betrayal and uses the planeswalker's life to engineer Phyrexia's demise.
timeline.quote: Urza predicted Tevesh Szat’s eventual betrayal, using the draconic Planeswalker’s life to engineer Phyrexia’s demise.

timeline.summary: Urza, obsessed with Dominaria's history and the Thran Empire, begins a millennia-long vendetta against Yawgmoth and Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: This led to a millennia-long vendetta against Yawgmoth and the plane of Phyrexia.
